name: Project Homeless Connect
description: Free one-stop access to health, ID, benefits, and other services for people experiencing homelessness
fullDescription: Project Homeless Connect connects San Franciscans experiencing homelessness with the care they need, through its office, mobile services, phone help, and large Community Days of Service.
whatTheyOffer:
- Community Days of Service with 60+ service providers under one roof
- DMV California ID cards, dental, medical, and mental health services at events
- Help with medical benefits and employment resources
- Drop-in services at the PHC office
- Mobile off-site services
- Phone and email help from Service Facilitators
howToGetIt:
1. Check the PHC Services Calendar for upcoming events and service days
2. Drop in on Tuesdays, 9:30 AM–12:30 PM at 1031 Franklin Street, 2nd Floor
3. Or call the Resource Line at 1-855-588-7968 or email edc@projecthomelessconnect.org
4. Calls and emails are returned within two business days
address: 1031 Franklin Street, 2nd Floor, San Francisco, CA 94109
keywords: Project Homeless Connect, San Francisco, homeless services, Community Day of Service, hygiene, medical care, dental care, California ID, benefits enrollment, one-stop
